description: CALL THIS when the user asks about an artist's identity or body of work: "who is King Ahkeem", "what else has 183 Wildboi made", "tell me about Dre50". Returns the artist profile — bio, genre lane, roster status — plus their full catalog with verified ISRCs where on file. Use get_track when the user asks about one specific song.
